title: Measurement-Induced Quantum Neural Network
summary: We introduce a measurement-induced quantum neural network (MINN), an adaptive monitored-circuit architecture in which mid-circuit measurement outcomes determine the entangling gates in subsequent layers. In contrast to standard monitored circuits where sites and gates are sampled randomly, the gates are parametrized and variational, producing correlated history-dependent dynamics and injecting nonlinearity through measurement back-action.
